te: Student loan working group plan, and appointing more subcommittee members
se: The chair of the student loan working group reported its work plan, including following up answers to the questions sent to the Fund, and the committee considered appointing members of the Subcommittee on Learning Promotion, Private Education, Special Education and Educational Equality and honorary advisers to the committee.
it: Work plan of the student loan working group
Appointing members of the learning promotion subcommittee and honorary advisers

te: Meeting summary video · Student loan working group plan, and appointing more subcommittee members
The Cabinet accepts proposals on preparing graduates for the labour market
se: The chair reported that the Cabinet has considered the committee's report on policy proposals to develop graduates with the knowledge, skills and ethics the labour market needs, and accepted all the proposals, assigning the agencies concerned to act on them. The committee will follow up. The higher education subcommittee then presented its draft report on policy proposals for cooperative and work-integrated education (CWIE).
it: The Cabinet's decision on the report on preparing graduates for the labour market
Draft report on policy proposals for cooperative education and CWIE

te: Meeting summary video · The Cabinet accepts proposals on preparing graduates for the labour market
How to put medical, agricultural and food research to real use
se: The higher education subcommittee presented its draft report on putting medical, health, agricultural and food research to use, which found six main problems, such as research questions that do not match users' real needs, research funding that is not linked between agencies and is short-term, and a lack of ready manpower. The committee also considered a letter from the Federation of Teachers' Associations of Thailand asking it to consider the Teachers and Educational Personnel Council Bill (No. ..) based on the participation of the profession.
it: Draft report on putting medical, health, agricultural and food research to use
Letter from the Federation of Teachers' Associations of Thailand on the Teachers Council Bill

te: Meeting summary video · How to put medical, agricultural and food research to real use
Proposals on student loan debt, and ten groups of questions for the Fund
se: The student loan working group reported progress and proposals on debt management, such as linking data with the credit bureau, payroll deduction through employers, and loan forms that state study and career goals to link with the labour market. The committee approved sending ten groups of questions to the Student Loan Fund, such as on the Fund's cash flow and its financial position and repayments.
it: Progress of the student loan working group
Sending ten groups of questions to the Student Loan Fund

te: The Teachers and Educational Personnel Council Bill, and proposals from university staff
se: The education and vocational education subcommittee reported its study of the Teachers and Educational Personnel Council Bill (No. ..) B.E. .... under Rule 119 of the Senate Rules of Procedure, using one draft as the main text together with seven other drafts. The committee considered policy proposals from the Khon Kaen University staff council on welfare and human resource management for university employees.
it: Teachers and Educational Personnel Council Bill (No. ..) B.E. .... (Rule 119)
Policy proposals on university employees' welfare (Khon Kaen University staff council)

te: Transnational higher education, and a meeting request from a UK university
se: The higher education subcommittee reported that the British Council Thailand said a senior international affairs executive of the University of Leicester in the United Kingdom wished to meet the committee to exchange views on higher education policy. It reported information from MHESI on policies to promote internationalisation and transnational education by foreign universities in Thailand, and proposed a schedule for its working groups to report completed studies.
it: Meeting request from the University of Leicester through the British Council Thailand
Policies on transnational higher education and internationalisation
Schedule for the working groups' reports

te: A forum on educational equality, and the student loan working group
se: The committee noted the public hearing “Policy mechanisms to raise learning promotion, private education, special education and educational equality in Thailand” on 9 September 2026 at Parliament House, and considered ways to solve problems with Student Loan Fund loans with the working group studying the issue.
it: Public hearing on learning promotion and educational equality (9 September 2026)
Ways to solve problems with Student Loan Fund loans (working group)

te: A seminar on the National Education Bill, and solving student loan problems
se: The committee noted that the subcommittee would hold the academic seminar “Next Gen Education Thailand: the National Education Bill for Thailand's Future” on 2 September 2026 in Bangkok, heard progress on the learning promotion subcommittee's public hearing, and began considering ways to solve problems with loans from the Student Loan Fund to create learning opportunities for people who lack means.
it: Academic seminar “Next Gen Education Thailand: the National Education Bill” (2 September 2026)
Progress of the learning promotion subcommittee's public hearing
Ways to solve problems with Student Loan Fund loans

te: A complaint about a gratuity, and complaints from people in the lower South
se: The committee considered a complaint from a pensioner of the Ministry of Education who claims that years of service could not be counted continuously for an extra gratuity after resigning to stand for election and later returning to government service. The committee agreed to send the matter to OBEC to check the facts, and considered complaints received through the Senators Meet the People project for the lower southern region.
it: Complaint asking for fairness in claiming an extra gratuity
Complaints from the Senators Meet the People project, lower southern region

te: Safety in schools after a student used a gun in Nonthaburi
se: The committee heard OBEC, the Office of the Welfare Promotion Commission for Teachers and Educational Personnel, the Nonthaburi Secondary Educational Service Area Office, school leaders, the Ministry of Social Development and Human Security and Nonthaburi Provincial Police on the case of a student who used a gun at a school in Bang Kruai District, Nonthaburi, in which people were injured and died, to gather full information for measures to prevent such events and keep students safe. It also followed up a complaint asking for a review of the 2020 royal decree reducing land and building tax.
it: A student's use of a gun at a school in Nonthaburi (OBEC, OTEP, Nonthaburi Secondary Educational Service Area Office, Ministry of Social Development, police)
Progress on a complaint asking for a review of the 2020 royal decree reducing land and building tax

se: According to the meeting notice, the agenda was the work of all three subcommittees. The summary will be added after the Senate publishes it.
it: Work of the subcommittees

te: Rajamangala university bills and three academic seminars
se: The higher education subcommittee reported its study of the Rajamangala University of Technology Thanyaburi Bill B.E. .... and the Rajamangala University of Technology Bill (No. ..) B.E. .... under Rule 119 of the Senate Rules of Procedure. The committee considered a seminar “Breaking the Deadlock in Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation” with MHESI, and approved forums on “The Future of Thai Education: the National Education Bill” and on “Policy mechanisms to raise learning promotion, private education, special education and educational equality in Thailand”.
it: Study of the Rajamangala University of Technology Thanyaburi Bill and the Rajamangala University of Technology Bill (No. ..) (Rule 119)
Seminar “Breaking the Deadlock in Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation”
Forums on “The Future of Thai Education: the National Education Bill” and on educational equality

te: Effects of the northeastern border situation on local schools
se: The committee heard OBEC on the effects of fighting along the northeastern border on schools in the area, especially the readiness of utilities and basic infrastructure needed for teaching, and approved the appointment of honorary advisers to the committee.
it: Effects of the northeastern border situation on education (OBEC)
Appointing honorary advisers to the committee
